title: Sales Service Manager- Urgent Hiring
description:
**Rommelag Engineering India – The perfect place to fulfill your needs**
Would you like to play an active role in ensuring that people worldwide have access to safe medicines?
  
  
Would you like to become part of the
**Rommelag Group**
, with over 2,000 employees and worldwide – the one-stop partner for the aseptic filling of liquid pharmaceuticals?
  
  
**Rommelag Engineering India**
is engaged in manufacturing of spare parts, moulds, and accessories of State-of-the-Art machines (Blow-Fill-Seal machines) being used in pharmaceutical industries for filling I.V. fluids, ear drops, eye drops, etc, all the leading pharmaceutical companies in India and abroad are the prospective customers/users of this machine.
  
  
The BFS machines are manufactured at the holding company’s factories in Rommelag Switzerland and Rommelag Germany.
  
  
**Sounds good? Then apply now in less than 10 minutes – we look forward to hearing from you!**
**Job Summary**
**These are your responsibilities**
We are looking for a highly driven and technically strong Sales Service Manager to lead our aftermarket sales and customer development initiatives.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have deep technical understanding of industrial machinery, mould systems, spare parts, machine upgrades, and process improvements — combined with strong commercial and relationship-building skills.
  
  
**This is not a conventional sales role**
. The candidate must be capable of understanding machine performance issues, identifying technical improvement opportunities, proposing engineering solutions, and convincingly presenting the value of modifications, retrofits, spare parts, mould overhauls, and new projects to customers.
  
  
The role requires close interaction with customers, service teams, engineering departments, and manufacturing plants to drive long-term service business growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Sales & Business Development

Drive sales growth for spare parts, machine retrofits, upgrades, mould overhauling projects, new mould sales, and service contracts.
  
  
Identify customer pain points related to machine performance, downtime, maintenance, and production efficiency.
  
  
Recommend suitable technical solutions and convince customers on the technical and commercial benefits.
  
  
Develop long-term aftermarket and service business within the assigned territory.
  
  

* Technical Expertise & Customer Support

Strong understanding of BFS machines (preferably), mould systems, mechanical assemblies, pneumatics, hydraulics, and machine wear parts.
  
  
Ability to understand machine problems, analyze failures, and propose technical improvements.
  
  
Read and interpret technical drawings, layouts, spare part catalogs, and service reports.
  
  
Conduct technical discussions confidently with production, maintenance, engineering, and purchase teams.
  
  

* Customer Relationship & Aftermarket Growth

Build strong long-term customer relationships through proactive technical support and regular visits.
  
  
Increase recurring business through spare parts sales, annual maintenance support, machine refurbishment, and upgrade opportunities.
  
  
Support resolution of complaints, technical issues, and overdue matters professionally and efficiently.
  
  

* Internal Coordination & Industry Representation

Work closely with service, engineering, finance, manufacturing, and sales support teams for smooth project execution.
  
  
Support and coordinate with sales/service agents where applicable.
  
  
Represent the company professionally at customer meetings, trade fairs, seminars, and technical events.
  
  
**Your Skills & Qualifications**
**Education**
Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechatronics, or related technical field.
  
  
Additional sales or business development exposure is an advantage.
  
  
**Experience**

* 12+ years of experience in technical sales, service sales, or aftermarket business for industrial machinery/capital equipment.
* Strong experience in machine upgrades, spare parts business, service project handling, and technical customer discussions.
* Experience in BFS (Blow-Fill-Seal), packaging machinery, pharmaceutical machinery, or related industries is highly preferred.

**Required Skills**

* Strong technical sales capability
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills
* Ability to understand customer technical problems and propose solutions
* Strong commercial understanding
* Project coordination and follow-up skills
* Customer-focused mindset
* Ability to work independently and drive business growth

**Languages**
Excellent English and Hindi communication skills
  
  
**Travel Requirement**
Willingness to travel extensively within assigned territory for customer visits, project discussions, and service support.
  
  
**We are specifically looking for a technically strong sales professional who can:**

* Understand machines in depth
* Identify technical improvement opportunities
* Build customer trust through technical knowledge
* Drive aftermarket and service business growth
* Convert technical discussions into profitable business opportunities

**This role is ideal for candidates who enjoy both engineering discussions and business development.**
**Our Benefits**
**What we offer you:**

* Secure future: A company pension plan and a lifetime working time account give you security for tomorrow.
* Team events: Regular team events and company parties ensure fun and team spirit.
* Top working environment: With employee Wi-Fi, a cool employee app, breakfast and lunch options at Factory location, and much more.

**Have we sparked your interest?**
Then apply now using our online application form.
  
  
At Rommelag, we are on first-name terms across all hierarchical levels—it's part of our corporate culture. We would be delighted if you would also address us by our first names in your application documents.
  
  
Diversity is very important to us at Rommelag! It is important to us that you feel welcome here, regardless of your gender, origin, religion, worldview, disability, age, sexual orientation, or identity.
  
  
Looking forward to receiving your application:

title: Placement Officer
company: Vaisiri Institute of Management and Technology
description:
**Company Description** 
 Vaisiri Institute of Management and Technology is an educational institution focused on developing skilled, industry\-ready graduates in management and technology disciplines. The institute emphasizes practical learning, professional development, and strong academic standards to prepare learners for evolving workforce needs. Located in Tumkur, it works closely with employers and industry partners to align its programs with current market expectations. The institute encourages innovation, ethical practices, and continuous learning, creating an environment where both learners and staff can grow professionally.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Placement Officer role is a full\-time, on\-site position based at the Tumkur campus. The Placement Officer will coordinate campus placement activities, including scheduling recruitment drives, liaising with companies, and maintaining employer relationships. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include guiding learners on resume preparation, interview skills, and career paths, as well as organizing training sessions, workshops, and industry interactions. The role also involves tracking placement outcomes, maintaining placement records, preparing reports, and collaborating with academic teams to align learner readiness with employer expectations. The Placement Officer will represent the institute professionally to external stakeholders and support initiatives that enhance the institute’s placement performance.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess skills in campus placement coordination and employer relationship management.
* Candidates should possess strong communication skills, including presentation and interpersonal abilities.
* Candidates should possess skills in career counseling, learner mentoring, and guidance on career paths.
* Candidates should possess skills in training and workshop facilitation related to employability and soft skills.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of the education sector, particularly management and technology programs.
* Relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree in Management, Education, Human Resources, or a related field.
* Prior experience in placement, corporate relations, or career services in an academic setting is preferred.
* Ability to build networks with recruiters, analyze placement data, and work collaboratively with faculty and administration.

title: Recruiter
description:
**Company Description** 
 Grofresh Agrofoods Pvt. Ltd. is a leading food processing company based in Tumakuru, Karnataka, India. The organization specializes in processing IQF and frozen fruits, vegetables, pulp, and purees for a variety of markets and customers. Grofresh Agrofoods focuses on quality, food safety, and consistency across its product range. Team members work in a dynamic environment that supports growth in the agro\-foods and food processing sector. The company values reliability, innovation, and long\-term partnerships with both employees and clients.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Recruiter will manage end\-to\-end hiring activities for various roles within Grofresh Agrofoods, ensuring alignment with organizational needs and timelines. This full\-time, on\-site position is based in Tumakuru and involves sourcing candidates, screening resumes, conducting interviews, and coordinating selection processes with hiring managers. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include maintaining job postings, engaging with potential candidates through different channels, and managing communication throughout the recruitment cycle. The Recruiter will help build talent pipelines, support onboarding activities, and maintain accurate recruitment records and reports. This role also involves collaborating with HR and operations teams to understand workforce requirements, support employer branding initiatives, and ensure a fair, inclusive, and compliant hiring process.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Experience in end\-to\-end recruitment, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and coordinating hiring decisions.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport with candidates and internal stakeholders.
* Ability to work on\-site in Tumakuru and collaborate effectively with HR, operations, and management teams.
* Familiarity with applicant tracking systems, job portals, and professional networking platforms.
* Strong organizational and time\-management abilities to handle multiple roles and deadlines.
* Knowledge of HR best practices, basic labor regulations, and inclusive hiring principles.
* Prior experience in manufacturing, food processing, or agro\-based industries is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
